note: 表情预设：来源 PixTV 9 种表情指南（4 张）+ 女生微表情 150 组（5 张）。性别、镜头、画质词已去掉，只留表情本身；中英双语。

items.zh: 无声流泪，眼眶泛红，泪珠顺着脸颊滑落，唇瓣微颤
items.en: silent tears, reddened eyes, a tear rolling down the cheek, lips trembling

items.zh: 崩溃大哭，眼泪不断，张大嘴巴，眉头紧皱
items.en: crying uncontrollably, tears streaming, mouth wide open, brows knitted

items.zh: 咬唇忍哭，眼眶含泪，嘴唇紧咬，眼神委屈
items.en: biting the lip to hold back tears, eyes brimming, aggrieved look

items.zh: 怒目直视，眼神凌厉，眉头紧皱，嘴唇紧抿
items.en: glaring straight ahead, fierce eyes, brows knitted, lips pressed

items.zh: 愤怒争吵，张大嘴巴，眉毛紧皱，面部肌肉紧绷
items.en: angry argument, mouth wide open, brows furrowed, facial muscles tense

items.zh: 不屑冷笑，嘴角上扬，眼神轻蔑，微挑眉
items.en: scornful smirk, one corner of the mouth raised, contemptuous eyes, one brow cocked

items.zh: 极度委屈，眼眶含泪，眉头微皱，嘴唇微抿，楚楚可怜
items.en: deeply wronged, eyes welling up, brows slightly drawn, lips pursed, pitiful

items.zh: 隐忍克制，眼神沉静，眼眶微红，嘴唇紧抿
items.en: restrained side profile, calm eyes, slightly reddened rims, lips pressed

items.zh: 茫然失神，眼神空洞，嘴唇微张，神情迷茫
items.en: blank and dazed, hollow eyes, lips slightly parted, lost expression

items.zh: 惊讶震惊，眼睛睁大，瞳孔放大，嘴巴微张，手捂住嘴，眉毛上扬
items.en: shocked, wide eyes, pupils dilated, mouth slightly open, hand covering the mouth, brows raised

items.zh: 开心大笑，眼睛弯成月牙，嘴角上扬露齿笑，脸部放松，发丝飘动
items.en: laughing happily, eyes curved into crescents, teeth showing, face relaxed, hair moving

items.zh: 温柔含笑，嘴角微扬，眼神温柔，眉眼放松
items.en: gentle smile, corners of the mouth lifted, tender eyes, relaxed brows

items.zh: 冷漠疏离，眼神侧视，表情平静，嘴唇紧闭，眼神清冷
items.en: cold and distant, looking sideways, flat expression, lips shut, cool eyes

items.zh: 疑惑不解，眉头微皱，眼神迷茫，嘴唇微张，手托下巴
items.en: puzzled, brows slightly furrowed, confused eyes, mouth ajar, chin on hand

items.zh: 惊恐害怕，眼睛睁大，瞳孔放大，嘴巴张开，眉毛上扬，身体后仰
items.en: terrified, eyes wide, pupils dilated, mouth open, brows raised, leaning back

items.zh: 害羞脸红，眼神躲闪，脸颊泛红，嘴唇微抿，双手挡住嘴
items.en: shy and blushing, eyes darting away, flushed cheeks, lips pursed, hands over the mouth

items.zh: 思考沉思，眼神专注，嘴唇紧抿，手拿笔靠下巴，眉头微蹙
items.en: lost in thought, focused eyes, lips pressed, pen resting against the chin, brows slightly knitted

items.zh: 轻蔑不屑，眼神斜视，嘴角轻抬，眉毛微挑
items.en: disdainful, glancing sideways, mouth corner lifted, one brow raised

items.zh: 深情凝视，眼神温柔专注，微微湿润，嘴唇微张，手托脸
items.en: gazing affectionately, tender focused eyes, slightly moist, lips parted, hand against the cheek

items.zh: 灿烂大笑，眼睛弯成月牙，露出牙齿，脸颊上扬
items.en: radiant laugh, eyes curved, teeth showing, cheeks lifted

items.zh: 惊讶吃惊，眼睛瞪大，嘴巴微张，手捂住嘴，眉毛上扬
items.en: startled, eyes wide, mouth slightly open, hand over the mouth, brows raised

items.zh: 魅惑眼神，眼神迷离，嘴唇微张，手指轻触嘴唇
items.en: alluring gaze, hazy eyes, lips parted, fingers touching the lips

items.zh: 疲惫倦怠，眼神无力，眼下微暗，嘴唇放松，侧脸靠在手臂上
items.en: exhausted, heavy eyes, faint shadows under the eyes, lips relaxed, cheek resting on the arm

items.zh: 傲娇别扭，嘴巴嘟起，眼神看向一侧，眉毛微皱，脸颊微鼓
items.en: tsundere pout, lips pushed out, looking away, brows slightly drawn, cheeks puffed

items.zh: 担忧不安，眉头紧皱，眼神焦虑，手指轻咬，嘴唇紧抿
items.en: worried, brows tight, anxious eyes, fingers at the lips, mouth pressed

items.zh: 坚定冷静，眼神锐利，嘴唇紧抿，下颌线紧致
items.en: resolute and calm, sharp eyes, lips pressed, tight jawline

items.zh: 无辜可怜，眼神水汪汪，眉尾下撇，嘴唇微嘟，双手托下巴
items.en: innocent and pitiful, watery eyes, outer brows drooping, lips slightly pouting, chin in both hands

items.zh: 温柔宠溺，眼神温柔，微微浅笑，嘴角上扬，眼神含情
items.en: tender and doting, soft eyes, faint smile, mouth corners lifted, affectionate look

items.zh: 嘲讽轻蔑，眼神斜视，嘴角微扬，表情冷淡
items.en: mocking, sidelong glance, slight smirk, cold expression

items.zh: 疼痛难忍，眉头紧皱，眼睛紧闭，嘴唇紧咬，脸上有擦伤
items.en: in pain, brows clenched, eyes shut, teeth gritted, a graze on the face

items.zh: 含情凝望，目光温柔又专注，眼底有光
items.en: gazing with feeling, tender and focused eyes, a light in them

items.zh: 羞涩垂眸，眼睫轻垂不敢直视，耳尖泛红
items.en: bashfully lowering the eyes, lashes down, ear tips flushed

items.zh: 抿唇窃喜，唇角悄悄扬起，眼里藏着笑意
items.en: secretly pleased, lips pursed, corners of the mouth creeping up, a smile hidden in the eyes

items.zh: 怦然错愕，双眼倏地睁圆，唇微张
items.en: caught off guard, eyes suddenly round, lips slightly open

items.zh: 小嘴微嘟，眉心轻蹙，眼神里带点委屈
items.en: small pout, brow slightly drawn, a hint of grievance in the eyes

items.zh: 温软浅笑，唇角淡淡扬起，眼神软而暖
items.en: soft warm smile, mouth corners gently raised, eyes soft

items.zh: 话到嘴边，唇微张开又停住，欲说还休
items.en: words on the lips, mouth half open then stopping, hesitant to speak

items.zh: 目光闪躲，视线飞快移开，脸颊悄悄泛红
items.en: eyes darting away, glance fleeing quickly, cheeks quietly flushing

items.zh: 脉脉深望，眼神深邃又温柔，专注地望进对方眼里
items.en: deep affectionate gaze, intense and tender, looking into the other's eyes

items.zh: 笑意弯眸，眼睛自然弯成月牙，笑容清亮带甜
items.en: smiling eyes, naturally curved into crescents, bright sweet smile

items.zh: 倏然抬眸，视线猛地向上一抬，眼微睁
items.en: eyes suddenly lifted upward, slightly widened

items.zh: 瞳仁轻颤，眼睛睁大，目光骤然聚焦，手不自觉掩住唇
items.en: pupils quivering, eyes wide, gaze snapping into focus, hand unconsciously covering the lips

items.zh: 将信将疑，眉头浅蹙，目光飘向一侧，唇轻抿
items.en: half believing, half doubting, brows slightly drawn, gaze drifting aside, lips lightly pressed

items.zh: 侧首探看，头微歪，目光自上而下探来，唇角轻抿
items.en: head tilted, peering, gaze sweeping down, mouth corners pressed

items.zh: 抿唇揣度，唇轻抿着，视线悄悄滑向一旁
items.en: weighing something up, lips pressed, glance sliding quietly aside

items.zh: 斜睨打量，头微侧，眼神从眼角扫过，神情专注又谨慎
items.en: sizing someone up with a sidelong look, head slightly turned, eyes scanning from the corner, focused and cautious

items.zh: 蓦然定格，目光忽然凝住，唇微张
items.en: frozen mid-thought, gaze suddenly fixed, lips slightly parted

items.zh: 谨慎求证，眉心微蹙，目光认真落在对方身上
items.en: cautiously checking, brows faintly knitted, eyes resting seriously on the other person

items.zh: 目光追问，眼神锐利又专注，眉梢微挑，唇微启
items.en: pressing with a look, sharp and focused eyes, brow tip raised, lips barely open

items.zh: 话咽回去，唇微启又止，手托着腮，满眼纠结
items.en: swallowing the words back, lips parted then stopped, chin in hand, conflicted eyes

items.zh: 轻啮下唇，下唇被轻轻咬住，眼里裹着委屈与克制
items.en: lightly biting the lower lip, grievance and restraint in the eyes

items.zh: 泪盈于睫，眼眶泛红，泪珠在眼底打转却不掉
items.en: tears brimming on the lashes, reddened eyes, tears circling but not falling

items.zh: 倔然仰眸，下巴微抬，眼神倔强又笃定
items.en: chin lifted in defiance, stubborn determined eyes

items.zh: 垂首生闷，低着头不发一语，目光往下落，唇微抿
items.en: head down, silent and sulky, gaze lowered, lips pressed

items.zh: 含泪不语，眼里噙着泪却没出声，唇轻抿着
items.en: silent with tears, eyes holding them back without a sound, lips lightly pressed

items.zh: 眼尾泛红，目光还湿着，像刚哭过
items.en: reddened eye corners, still-wet gaze, as if just done crying

items.zh: 强颜浅笑，明明心里难过，还努力挤出一个淡淡的笑
items.en: forced faint smile, clearly sad inside, still forcing a slight smile

items.zh: 鼻尖微微泛红，目光酸涩，忍着泪
items.en: nose tip faintly red, stinging gaze, holding back tears

items.zh: 鼓腮侧脸，脸偏向一边，腮帮微鼓，唇嘟着
items.en: cheeks puffed, face turned aside, lips pouting

items.zh: 黯然低落，眼神空落落垂下，神色落寞
items.en: dejected, eyes dropping empty and low, lonely expression

items.zh: 淡漠挑眉，眼神清冷又笃定，眉梢轻轻一挑
items.en: indifferent brow lift, cool assured eyes, one brow raised slightly

items.zh: 浅嗤侧目，唇角微微一扬，眼神斜扫过，写着不屑
items.en: faint scoff with a sidelong glance, mouth corner lifted, dismissive eyes

items.zh: 傲然垂眸，眼睑微垂，神情高傲清冷，眼皮都懒得抬
items.en: haughty lowered lids, proud cold expression, barely bothering to look up

items.zh: 懒散疏离，手托着腮，目光飘在别处，神情松垮又冷淡
items.en: languid and aloof, chin on hand, gaze drifting elsewhere, loose indifferent expression

items.zh: 笑里藏压，唇角勾起浅浅笑意，眼神却凌厉
items.en: smile with pressure behind it, faint smile at the mouth, blade-sharp eyes

items.zh: 微扬下巴，目光居高临下，神色从容不迫
items.en: chin slightly raised, looking down on the viewer, composed expression

items.zh: 清冷远望，目光冷静而遥远，情绪不露
items.en: cold distant look, calm faraway gaze, no emotion showing

items.zh: 轻蔑一瞥，视线匆匆扫过，唇角微微一拉
items.en: contemptuous glance, a quick sweep of the eyes, mouth corner pulled

items.zh: 反诘神色，眉梢微挑，眼神锐利，唇角带着质疑
items.en: challenging look, brow cocked, sharp eyes, a questioning mouth

items.zh: 唇角一撇，目光别开，腮帮微鼓，表面嫌弃
items.en: mouth pulled aside, eyes turned away, cheeks puffed, pretending to be put off

items.zh: 弯眸甜笑，眼睛微微眯起，唇角上扬
items.en: sweet smile, eyes softly narrowed, mouth corners lifted

items.zh: 歪头甜望，头微微歪着，眼里盛着笑
items.en: head tilted sweetly, eyes full of laughter

items.zh: 软糯撒娇，双眼水汪汪，唇轻嘟起，手拽着衣角
items.en: coy and soft, watery eyes, lips pouting, fingers tugging at the hem

items.zh: 星光满眸，眼睛睁得又大又亮，唇微张，神情兴奋
items.en: eyes full of starlight, wide and bright, lips parted, excited

items.zh: 笑涡浅浅，唇角扬起自然的弧，眼神温暖明亮
items.en: faint dimples, a natural curve at the mouth, warm bright eyes

items.zh: 晃首俏皮，脑袋轻轻左右摇，眼睛弯弯含笑
items.en: head rocking playfully side to side, eyes curved in a smile

items.zh: 偷瞄暗喜，眼神悄悄瞥向一旁，唇角忍不住上扬
items.en: sneaking a glance, secretly delighted, gaze slipping aside, mouth corners rising

items.zh: 微微得色，下巴轻轻一扬，眼里掠过一丝小骄傲
items.en: smug, chin lifted slightly, a flicker of pride in the eyes

items.zh: 乖顺颔首，轻轻点头，眼神清亮乖巧，唇角带笑
items.en: obedient nod, clear well-behaved eyes, a smile at the mouth

items.zh: 俏皮眨眼，一只眼俏皮地眨起，唇角扬起活泼的笑
items.en: playful wink, one eye shut, a lively smile
